cohort: The study included 10 recipients who underwent hysterectomy after uterus transplantation between 2012 and 2020.
finding: Hysterectomy after uterus transplantation is a complex and time-consuming procedure, and early cervical biopsies showing ischemic signs may indicate subsequent irreversible damage leading to graft failure.
mod_finding: Hysterectomy in recipients was performed in conjunction with cesarean section (n=3) or 3-6 months after cesarean section (n=3).
